ecological_hypothesis: If relief of evaporative water-balance constraint is an important proximal driver of rainfall-associated chorus activation, smaller-bodied species should show stronger dry=0 -> wet CallingIndex 2-3 activation because surface-area-to-volume scaling generally increases relative water-loss vulnerability at smaller body size.

response.focal_event: dry CallingIndex=0 and wet CallingIndex in {2,3} at a species x stop cell
response.pair_species_score: Sum wet CallingIndex over focal cells for each species within each matched pair.
response.species_beta: For each species, fit pair_species_score ~ rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber with route-clustered covariance.
response.response_eligibility: Species must have >=20 focal cells distributed across >=5 routes in the full sample.

trait.source: AmphiBIO v1 pinned raw snapshot used by the existing frogcs trait audit.
trait.taxonomy: Exact binomial matching plus frozen Hyla<->Dryophytes and Lithobates<->Rana genus aliases; ambiguous complex labels are excluded unless an exact AmphiBIO row exists.

coverage_gate: At least 20 response-eligible species must have finite positive Body_size_mm and body-size SD >0; otherwise the mechanism test is not run.

primary_test.statistic: Rain-contrast coefficient of a pair-level size-load endpoint: sum(focal wet CallingIndex * z_log_body_size) over trait-matched species. Body size is z-scored across matched response-eligible species.
primary_test.null: 10,000 deterministic species-label permutations of z_log_body_size, leaving all acoustic responses, pair structure and covariates fixed.
primary_test.decision: One-sided permutation P<0.05 in the negative direction.

supporting_outputs: OLS species-beta ~ z_log_body_size slope with HC3 SE.
Spearman correlation between species beta and log body size.
Repeat the size-load statistic in the same-observer + physical-stop robust pair subset; sign concordance is a robustness check, not a second primary gate.
interpretation: A negative association would be consistent with a hydration/water-balance pathway but would not establish mediation; body size covaries with many life-history and phylogenetic traits.
A null association would weaken simple body-size-mediated hydration as a general explanation but would not exclude hydration physiology.
No new trait may be promoted after readback under this contract.
No causal rainfall, abundance, occupancy, or reproductive-success claim is authorized.
